message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a grey background and red header accents. In the center, a large, open metal safe is depicted with a heavy, thick door swung to the right. Emerging from the dark interior of the safe is a man with short brown hair, wearing a dark green button-down shirt. He is shown from the waist up, with his right hand gripping the bottom edge of the safe’s opening. Behind him, another man with grey hair and a tan shirt is visible, along with dark silhouettes of two other figures. 

The large red text "TEMPO" dominates the top, accompanied by the number "55" in red. Above it, black text reads "Manuver Gerindra di RUU Masyarakat Adat H.26" and "Musabab BBM Langka di Sumatera H.48". Below the title, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in smaller red letters. A bold black headline states "KANTONG BELAKANG FEBRIE ADRIANSYAH". To the left, a descriptive paragraph in Indonesian mentions "Febrie Adriansyah," "bisnis," and "pencucian uang." A barcode and publication details, including "27 JULI-2 AGUSTUS 2026," are in the bottom left corner.
